bundle: CanDoItAll Runtime, Tools, and Process Drivers
title: Core handoff anchor, ownership review, and runtime inventory

tasks.title: Verify Core C4 handoff
tasks.description: Confirm exact passing commit, active CI, support matrix, migrations, open limitations, and no uncommitted operator work. Stop if the handoff is incomplete.

tasks.title: Rebase all runtime source references
tasks.description: Compare prepared commit and Core C4 HEAD; update renamed files/projects, new process/tool surfaces, and requirement ownership.

tasks.title: Generate full runtime execution inventory
tasks.description: Find every ProcessStartInfo, Process, shell/script, terminal, executable resolver, environment binder, watcher, WMI/proc, MCP stdio, external tool, Docker/FileTools, and process-driver call path.

tasks.title: Map authoritative ownership
tasks.description: For each surface record plan compiler, execution primitive, lifecycle owner, process registry, cancellation/kill, capability probe, receipt/evidence, UI presentation, recovery, and domain failure owner.

tasks.title: Characterize current behavior on all OSes
tasks.description: Run existing process-host, Workbench, Manager, MCP, plugin, and process-driver tests; add no implementation yet. Capture process trees, output, environment, and failure modes.

tasks.title: Review external package/native dependencies
tasks.description: Record FileTools package, Docker, node/npm/npx, Playwright MCP, PowerShell, Python/Conda, terminal, WMI, procfs/libproc/ps, Keychain/Secret Service interactions, versions, and support evidence.

tasks.title: Apply split triggers
tasks.description: If implementation exceeds 60 production files, crosses more than 8 project ownership boundaries, needs external package source changes, or cannot preserve independent gates, create child execution bundles before edits.

tasks.title: Issue Gate R0
tasks.description: Require no unclassified P0/P1 runtime surface and approve the B01–B07 ownership/dependency graph.
